rules.originality: All outputs must be original. Public references may inform information hierarchy, readability, generic camera angle and category conventions only; never copy competitor-specific characters, icons, buildings, UI skins, logos or text.
globalStyle: warm healing neighborhood food-street casual game
deep warm-brown outline, never pure black

jobs.prompt_spec: Original casual-game asset sheet with four separate food icons: tomato, bell pepper, mushroom and carrot. 20-degree top-down view, warm brown soft outline, simplified rounded volumes, saturated but natural food colors, soft shadow under each object, strong silhouette, consistent scale and light from upper-left. No labels, no text.

Original casual-game asset sheet showing a progression of coffee beans, espresso cup, warm coffee and iced coffee. 20-degree top-down view, same family language, increasing visual richness without tiny-only differences, soft warm outline, clean highlights on liquid and glass, transparent background.

Original casual-game finished-dish asset sheet: lettuce salad, sugared tomato plate, mushroom-cheese roll and blueberry drink. Food occupies the visual focus, dishware secondary, 20-degree top-down, soft warm outline, appetizing saturated colors, transparent background.

Original kitchen supply producer for a merge-and-cooking game: compact wooden-and-cream supply crate with visible organized vegetable prep supplies, friendly rounded silhouette, 3/4 view, orange/cream/green palette, large readable shapes, designed to support Ready, Cooldown and Boosted state overlays.

Original drink-mixing workstation for a cozy food-street game, cream and mint body with orange accents, small blender/shaker zone, 3/4 view, friendly rounded proportions, readable controls without text, visually distinct from supply producers.

Original young adult female neighborhood food-street manager named Youning. Warm practical personality. Fixed canon: cream apron, orange hair clip, small notebook; palette #F3B05A #FFF3DF outline #5C4638. Character design sheet with front, 3/4, side and back plus six facial expressions. Soft rounded 2D hand-painted casual-game style. Do not imitate any existing game character.
acceptance: fixed props present in every view

jobs.prompt_spec: Original anthropomorphic goose guide named Tuantuan for a neighborhood food-street game. Fixed canon: warm cream feathers, orange-yellow small scarf and wooden key tag; palette #FFF4D8 #F6B84B outline #76543A. Design sheet with front, 3/4, side and back plus six expressions. Friendly, talkative, compact rounded body but clearly original and not based on any existing goose character.
acceptance: scarf and wooden key tag fixed

jobs.prompt_spec: Original small Chinese neighborhood food-street storefront shown as a before/after pair on the same canvas, identical camera and footprint. Before: tired but safe facade, faded awning, sparse props. After: clean warm lively storefront, new awning, plants, hanging lights, steam detail. 3/4 game-world view, warm hand-painted 2D, no readable text, no logo.

Original mobile casual game UI style board: cream modal panel, orange primary button, pale secondary button, energy/coin/gem chips, order card. Use palette #FFF7E8 #FFFDF8 #F6A43A #78C65A #49B9F2 #F5C84C #EF5471 with warm brown #543C2F outlines. Large rounded corners, soft shadows, no text and no game logo.

Original 9x7 merge-board frame style anchor, cream-and-warm-orange border with subtle green accent, clean open cells and clearly different locked cells, large simple shapes, 76px logical cell design, no items, no text.
